clips.title: The story
paras: At Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale, night elf Orendil Broadleaf tends to the sick. His knowledge of forest plants helps him make remedies for young lives in the troubled woodlands.

At Maestra's Post on Ashenvale's western border, Orendil Broadleaf cares for the sick. The skilled healer knows the local herbs and how to use them in restorative remedies. He depends on travelers passing through to gather rare plants and other natural ingredients. Tension and conflict press closer to the forest, but Orendil remains focused on protecting his kin and easing their ailments.
